newsitem.title: USA: Sundance to open five communities in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Sundance to open five communities in 1997.

text.p: Sundance Homes Inc, which builds single family homes and runs manufactured home communities, said Thursday it expects to open five new communities in the first half of its 1997 fiscal year.
The additional communities will increase the number it operates to 17, Sundance said.
Earlier, Sundance reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.18 a share versus $0.01 a share last year.
Sundance chairman and chief executive Maurice Sanderman said he is cautiously optimistic about 1997.

"With the communities and projects currently under development, the communities already open and our improved operating efficiency, we believe we can improve on the results we achieved in fiscal 1996," Sanderman said, noting however that it is too early to give a specific forecast.

Sundance said its backlog at year-end was 197 homes versus 274 last year. The company said the decline is the result of its improved construction efficiency, and that it is able to deliver new homes to customers more rapidly.

In addition, refinements made in the homes over the last year, as well as greater construction efficiencies, enabled Sundance to complete a much larger percentage of homes in shorter time periods, thus reducing exposure to increases in material and labor costs.
"Similarly, our operating margin improved over the previous year as we realized the full year benefit of the cost reduction measures undertaken," Sanderman said.
